nodes.label: Escape stack
nodes.rationale: One Escape should close only the topmost layer; components stop the key once used or register on the shared stack (1.1.0/1.2.0).

nodes.label: Shared scroll lock
nodes.rationale: 14 modal surfaces each locked page scroll independently; nested closes unlocked under outer dialog, so one counted lock replaced them (1.1.0).

nodes.label: Scrim opacity 32%
nodes.rationale: ScrimTokens.ContainerOpacity is 0.32; library-wide sweep from bg-scrim/40 (0.8.0).

nodes.label: Motion tokens
nodes.rationale: androidx MotionTokens/Standard/Expressive springs, easings and durations exposed as CSS vars and JS (motionSprings, useSpring) (1.0.0).

nodes.label: Theme switch @property transition
nodes.rationale: Transitioning six color properties per element stuttered in Chromium; color tokens registered via @property transition once on <html>; Firefox keeps .theme-transitioning (1.0.0).

nodes.label: shape-morph
nodes.rationale: First hard runtime dependency (MIT, ~50KB), a TS port of androidx.graphics.shapes used by MShape (0.8.1).

nodes.label: Docs full-screen example apps (Desktop, Chat, Store, Mail, ...)
nodes.norm_label: docs full-screen example apps (desktop, chat, store, mail, ...)

nodes.label: MCarousel (port of Compose carousel keyline engine)
nodes.norm_label: mcarousel (port of compose carousel keyline engine)
nodes.rationale: Same-size items masked via clip-path; strategy depends on item count so inline :items doesn't re-snap.

nodes.label: Component catalog (Actions, Inputs, Data Display, Feedback, Navigation, Layout, ...)
nodes.norm_label: component catalog (actions, inputs, data display, feedback, navigation, layout, ...)

nodes.label: Dual-watcher race gotcha (MTabs indicator bug)
nodes.rationale: Inline array literals refire deep watchers; route all moves through the animated path.

nodes.label: Spring animations on plain JS + rAF, not CSS transitions
nodes.norm_label: spring animations on plain js + raf, not css transitions
nodes.rationale: CSS transitions leak onto instant code paths, can't retarget with velocity, and reactive :style bindings fight imperative writes.

nodes.label: Stiff springs need fixed 4ms substeps
nodes.rationale: Semi-implicit Euler diverges for stiffness ~3800 on dropped frames.

nodes.label: Enter/exit animations as precomputed Web Animations
nodes.norm_label: enter/exit animations as precomputed web animations
nodes.rationale: rAF runs on a busy main thread at panel mount; el.animate() is compositor-run so MNavigationDrawer open stopped janking on phones.

nodes.label: Adaptive layouts (useWindowSizeClass, MNavigationSuite, MListDetail, MSupportingPane)
nodes.rationale: Components classify their own size (ResizeObserver) rather than the window so they work in columns/dialogs.

nodes.label: Tailwind v4 container queries for self-sized layout
nodes.norm_label: tailwind v4 container queries for self-sized layout

nodes.label: MFab #content slot as FAB-anchored popover shell
nodes.norm_label: mfab #content slot as fab-anchored popover shell
nodes.rationale: Reuse instead of reimplementing open/close, outside-click, Escape; MFabMenu builds entirely on it; scrim kept as sibling to avoid inheriting panel transform.

nodes.label: Inline vs Modal picker pairs (not DRY)
nodes.norm_label: inline vs modal picker pairs (not dry)
nodes.rationale: Modal pickers duplicate calendar logic, Escape handling and scroll lock instead of using MDialog; fix bugs in both halves of a pair.

nodes.label: Porting M3 motion/dimensions from androidx Compose source
nodes.norm_label: porting m3 motion/dimensions from androidx compose source
nodes.rationale: m3.material.io is an unreadable SPA; androidx Kotlin source and token files give exact springs and dp values.

nodes.label: THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES
nodes.rationale: dist/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md written each build; build fails if a bundled dep lacks a license file (0.9.3).

nodes.label: Custom content escape hatches (bare prop, slot-scope, markers)
nodes.norm_label: custom content escape hatches (bare prop, slot-scope, markers)
nodes.rationale: Users ask for custom content after every redesign; all additive.

nodes.label: Drag-and-drop: Pointer Events + springs + FLIP
nodes.rationale: Native HTML5 DnD doesn't fire for touch, ghost unstyleable, can't animate siblings.

nodes.label: Generic <script setup> with interfaces in separate script block
nodes.norm_label: generic <script setup> with interfaces in separate script block

nodes.label: Testing interaction-heavy components under happy-dom
nodes.rationale: No layout in happy-dom: mock offsetTop/getBoundingClientRect, dispatch PointerEvents, prove bug fixes against old code.

nodes.label: Swipes along a scroll axis need touch events + directional touch-action
nodes.norm_label: swipes along a scroll axis need touch events + directional touch-action
nodes.rationale: Claim touch on first touchmove; pannable touch-action makes Chrome deliver touchmoves at 60Hz on 120Hz phones.

nodes.label: TransitionGroup leave with position:absolute needs pinned top
nodes.norm_label: transitiongroup leave with position:absolute needs pinned top

nodes.label: How changes are landed (version bump, verify, changelog, commit)
nodes.norm_label: how changes are landed (version bump, verify, changelog, commit)
nodes.rationale: Maintainer visually verifies each change in the docs site (real phone for touch) before changelog/commit; agents must not commit or write changelog first.

nodes.label: Publishing via v* tag and publish.yml (npm trusted publishing)
nodes.norm_label: publishing via v* tag and publish.yml (npm trusted publishing)

nodes.label: Material Design 3 visual identity (purple baseline palette, rounded-square app icon)
nodes.norm_label: material design 3 visual identity (purple baseline palette, rounded-square app icon)

nodes.label: Vue 'V' mark embedded in the M
nodes.norm_label: vue 'v' mark embedded in the m

nodes.label: Separate entry points (rich-text-editor, code-editor, markdown, terminal, chart, qrcode, barcode)
nodes.norm_label: separate entry points (rich-text-editor, code-editor, markdown, terminal, chart, qrcode, barcode)

nodes.label: Multiple lib entry points for heavy optional peer deps
nodes.norm_label: multiple lib entry points for heavy optional peer deps
nodes.rationale: Heavy deps (tiptap, codemirror, markdown-it, xterm, chart.js, qrcode, jsbarcode) live in dedicated entries so the main bundle stays light and deps can be optional peers.

nodes.label: Component named default re-export pattern (src/index.ts, _ private helpers)
nodes.norm_label: component named default re-export pattern (src/index.ts, _ private helpers)

nodes.label: Multi-root templates drop consumer attrs (inheritAttrs:false + v-bind $attrs)
nodes.norm_label: multi-root templates drop consumer attrs (inheritattrs:false + v-bind $attrs)
nodes.rationale: Guarded by attrsFallthrough.test.ts; template-root comments break TransitionGroup children in dev.

nodes.label: dist/API.md API reference for AI agents
nodes.community_name: dist/API.md API reference for AI agents
nodes.norm_label: dist/api.md api reference for ai agents

nodes.label: Contrast levels
nodes.rationale: Optional palettes-contrast stylesheet with medium/high contrast generated via material-color-utilities DynamicScheme (1.0.0).

nodes.label: dist/API.md
nodes.rationale: Compact API reference for AI coding agents generated by scripts/generate-api.mjs via vue-component-meta (0.9.1).

nodes.label: Server-side rendering
nodes.rationale: Library read localStorage/window at module load and crashed SSR; theme/palette now applied only in browser, isHydrating/initialState/cookies avoid mismatches (1.0.2-1.2.0).

nodes.label: Pointer Events drag-and-drop
nodes.rationale: Native HTML5 DnD never fires for touch on mobile and can't animate siblings; MDragDropList/MKanban rebuilt on Pointer Events + springs + FLIP (0.8.6).

nodes.label: Fragment-root attrs fallthrough
nodes.rationale: Multi-root templates (element + Teleport) silently dropped consumer class/attrs; fixed with inheritAttrs:false + v-bind=$attrs (0.8.1 fields, 0.9.0 the rest).

nodes.label: Menu panel registry
nodes.rationale: Teleported nested menus are DOM siblings, so outside-click/scroll checks used a provide/inject registry over the logical component tree (0.8.2).

nodes.label: touch-action narrowing for 120Hz
nodes.rationale: Chrome delivered touchmove at 60Hz where touch-action allowed panning along the drag; narrowing to none/pan-down restored 120Hz (1.0.1).

nodes.label: Web Animations enter/exit springs
nodes.rationale: rAF loops on the main thread janked on phones while content mounted; springs simulated up front and played via el.animate() run on the compositor (1.0.1).

nodes.label: Dynamic color (seed)
nodes.rationale: Whole scheme generated from one seed color via material-color-utilities (HCT), bundled but lazy-loaded and cached (0.9.2).

nodes.label: createM3UI() plugin (src/plugin.ts)
nodes.rationale: Palette seeded only on first visit so the user's persisted choice wins on later boots.

nodes.label: CSS import order (tailwindcss, theme, palettes, styles)
nodes.norm_label: css import order (tailwindcss, theme, palettes, styles)

nodes.label: Fonts setup (Material Symbols, Roboto, CDN or self-hosted)
nodes.norm_label: fonts setup (material symbols, roboto, cdn or self-hosted)
nodes.rationale: Library ships the icon CSS rule but not the font file; consumers supply fonts (self-host option for offline/firewalls).

nodes.label: Global rules in theme.css go inside @layer base
nodes.norm_label: global rules in theme.css go inside @layer base
nodes.rationale: Unlayered rules beat all layered utilities (scrollbar-none was overridden).
